## PR tag

Add one primary tag to the PR title:

- `[feature]` — adds or changes user-facing capability
- `[fix]` — corrects broken or unexpected behavior
- `[improvement]` — refines an existing experience without changing its purpose
- `[docs]` — changes documentation or project guidance
- `[chore]` — maintenance, tooling, or dependency work
- `[security]` — addresses a security or privacy concern

Optional secondary tags may describe the area: `[mobile]`, `[server]`, `[data]`, or `[design]`.

Example: `[feature] [mobile] Add ride replay`

## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? -->

## Verification

- [ ] I tested the relevant user flow.
- [ ] I included or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I checked for privacy and security impact.
